### Commit to Help

- [X] I commit to help with one of those options 👆

### Example Code

```python
from fastapi import FastAPI, Request

app = FastAPI()


@app.get("/app")
def read_main(request: Request):
    return {"message": "Hello World", "root_path": request.scope.get("root_path")}
```


### Description

running by ```fastapi run test.py --root-path /api/v1```, and open the swagger  with url ```http://127.0.0.1:8000/api/v1/docs```, it display ```{"detail":"Not Found"}```.

I try some cases, only setting ```app = FastAPI(app_root_path='/api/v1')``` and commond without the param ```root-path```, the swagger can display.

macOS

answer.body:
When you run app as `fastapi run test.py --root-path /api/v1`, it's supposed that you run it behind the proxy that strips prefix.
If not, Uvicorn adds the prefix second time and your app gets `http://127.0.0.1:8000/api/v1/api/v1/docs`.

So, you should configure proxy as shown in docs: https://fastapi.tiangolo.com/advanced/behind-a-proxy/#testing-locally-with-traefik
